provenance: Project-defined vocabulary. GraphForge Section 3.1 mentions 16 patterns but a complete authoritative definition was not confirmed; this is NOT that vocabulary.

patterns.quantitative_analysis: Calculate, model or compare quantities to support a professional decision.
patterns.reconciliation: Identify and explain discrepancies across records, reports or accounts.
patterns.information_synthesis: Find, compare and synthesize documented information into a supported account.
patterns.evaluation_and_selection: Evaluate alternatives against explicit criteria and recommend a choice.
patterns.document_authoring: Create a professional document from source material and requirements.
patterns.artifact_revision: Review and revise an existing professional artifact.
patterns.planning_and_policy: Develop a plan, schedule, procedure or policy using documented constraints.
patterns.software_development: Implement, debug or test software or structured digital systems.
